vocab_coverage.title: どうかしている
vocab_coverage.meaning: something wrong with (someone), not oneself, crazy, nuts

vocab_coverage.title: 炎
vocab_coverage.meaning: flame, blaze, flames (of intense emotion, e.g. love, jealousy, anger), passion

vocab_coverage.title: 顧みる
vocab_coverage.meaning: to look back (e.g. over shoulder or at the past), to turn around, to reflect on the past, to reconsider, to review, to reflect on oneself, to introspect, to contemplate oneself, to consider (usu. used in negative), to concern oneself about, to pay attention to, to take into consideration

vocab_coverage.title: 省みる
vocab_coverage.meaning: to reflect on (oneself, past conduct, etc.), to contemplate, to examine, to think over, to introspect

vocab_coverage.title: 朝方
vocab_coverage.meaning: early morning, early hours, early in the morning

vocab_coverage.title: 義兄
vocab_coverage.meaning: brother-in-law (spouse's older brother or older sister's husband), older stepbrother

vocab_coverage.title: 失言
vocab_coverage.meaning: verbal gaffe, verbal slip, slip of the tongue, using improper words

vocab_coverage.title: 海外赴任
vocab_coverage.furigana: 海外赴任（かいがいふにん）
